Armed Security Officer
Eagles Point Security Inc.

Job Overview

Eagles Point Security Inc. is currently seeking professional, reliable, and highly motivated Armed Security Officers to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment for clients, employees, and visitors while demonstrating strong professionalism and situational awareness.

We are looking for officers who can represent our company with integrity, professionalism, and excellent customer service skills.

Responsibilities

  • Patrol assigned properties and designated areas to deter criminal activity and unauthorized access
  • Monitor surveillance systems, cameras, alarms, and access control systems
  • Respond promptly to incidents, emergencies, alarms, and disturbances
  • Conduct detailed inspections of buildings, gates, doors, and access points
  • Enforce property rules, regulations, and security procedures
  • Complete accurate Daily Activity Reports (DARs) and incident reports
  • Provide exceptional customer service while maintaining a strong security presence
  • Assist with conflict resolution and de-escalation when necessary
  • Act lawfully in defense of life and property

Requirements

  • Valid Texas Level III Commissioned Security Officer License — REQUIRED
  • Valid CPR/First Aid Certification — REQUIRED
  • Current Baton Certification — REQUIRED
  • Current OC/Pepper Spray Certification — REQUIRED
  • Current Handcuff/Restraint Certification — REQUIRED
  • Strong communication skills in English (read, write, and speak) REQUIRED
  • Clean background and driving record REQUIRED
  • Ability to remain calm and professional under pressure
  • Experience in conflict management and de-escalation techniques
  • Knowledge of first aid and CPR is a plus
  • Familiarity with patrol procedures and loss prevention practices
  • Military, law enforcement, or prior security experience preferred
  • Reliable transportation and punctual attendance required

What We Offer

  • Competitive pay
  • Opportunities for overtime and advancement
  • Professional work environment
  • Ongoing support and leadership
  • Growth opportunities within a rapidly expanding security company

Apply Today

Join Eagles Point Security Inc. and become part of a team committed to professionalism, safety, and excellence in security services.

Overview

Why St. Moritz?

Are you looking for a rewarding career in the security industry? Join St. Moritz Security Services, Inc., a well -established company with over 43 years in the industry.

No security program can be successfully implemented without quality people to execute the program.

The ST. MORITZ DIFFERENCE is our PEOPLE.

From the first level security officer to the CEO, St. Moritz is committed from the top down to provide the highest level of service possible.

Job Skills / Requirements

Job Title: Armed Officer

Location: 11901 Cutten Rd, Houston, TX 77066

Pay: $18 per hour 40 HR

Schedule:Fri,Sat,Sun,Wed,Thu 10:00 pm-6:00 am

Primary Purpose and Function

  • Completes site checks and incident reports utilizing current technology.
  • Investigates and completes reports related to incidents and/or accidents.
  • Delivers orientation, training, development and is responsible for retention of high caliber staff; ensures that each staff member is treated with dignity and respect; coaches employees and carries out disciplinary actions, as necessary at the direction of the Manager.

  • A minimum of 1+ years of security experience is required.
  • Demonstrated skills in web searching and use of Excel and Word programs
  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills preferred.
  • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.

    • Friendly and professional demeanor in the delivery of quality customer service

    • Must be present in the field or office during assigned shift.
    • May require some local and long distance travel.

Armed Level III Security Officer


TriCorps Security is hiring professional and motivated Armed Level III Security Officers to join our team in Galena Park, Texas. Applicants must hold a valid Texas PSB Level III License (Armed Security Officer) and demonstrate reliability, professionalism, and sound judgment.


As a TriCorps officer, you will monitor and control access to client properties, protect personnel and assets, and maintain a visible and professional security presence. This role requires attention to detail, strong communication skills, and the ability to respond effectively to both routine and emergency situations.


Responsibilities

  • Secure premises and protect personnel by patrolling property and monitoring access points.
  • Inspect buildings, equipment, and access areas to ensure safety and compliance.
  • Prevent losses and damage by identifying irregularities, enforcing site policies, and reporting incidents.
  • Direct vehicle and pedestrian traffic to maintain safety and order.
  • Complete detailed and accurate reports documenting observations, incidents, and daily activities.
  • Interview witnesses and obtain relevant information when investigating security events.
  • Maintain operational readiness by completing preventive maintenance checks, reporting issues, and coordinating repairs.
  • Follow all management and client instructions to ensure consistent, high-quality service.

Professional Expectations

  • Maintain a professional appearance, demeanor, and attitude at all times.
  • Stay alert and observant throughout each shift to ensure proactive awareness of surroundings.
  • Communicate clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing.
  • Demonstrate sound judgment and composure in stressful situations.
  • Interact courteously and effectively with employees, visitors, and the public.
  • Uphold TriCorps’ standards of integrity, reliability, and service excellence.

Schedule & Work Environment

  • Positions available in Galena Park, Texas.
  • Flexible scheduling available with a maximum 36-hour workweek (non-consecutive).
  • Shifts may include days, nights, weekends, and holidays.


TriCorps is an integrated security and technology firm specializing in providing cost-effective, world-class services tailored to meet the needs of our clients.

Founded in 2000, TriCorps has spent more than twenty-five years delivering physical security, electronic security, and cybersecurity services across the nation. With branch locations in every region we serve, we’re proud to protect clients of every size and industry with integrity and innovation.

TriCorps is staffed with some of the most experienced security and technology professionals in the industry. Our leadership team includes former military personnel, retired law enforcement officers, and technology experts who bring hundreds of years of combined experience.

At TriCorps, we believe true security goes beyond protection—it’s built on partnership, trust, and excellence. We’re committed to innovation and continual improvement, setting the standard for integrated security and technology through our dedication to clients and our people.


TriCorps offers medical, vision, dental, and life insurance to employees, along with impressive employee assistance programs. We can offer full-time positions and also the flexibility of part-time schedules.
